Task 1:

The bar chart compares the number of domestic and international students on the basis of their gender studying at Computer Science department in a British university in 2010, 2011 and 2012.

Overall, the figure for domestic female students and international both male and female students increased substantially, whereas the number of local male students decreased initially. By contrast, the number of local men and women was higher than the figure for international students in any particular year.

It is noticed that, the number of United Kingdom born male students was just under 40, while there was only 20 male overseas students in 2010. However, the figure for British male student decreased to under 25 in 2011. On the contrary, the total number of male overseas student was increased slightly to more than 20 students although the figure was lower than the British students. However, the number of both domestic and international male students increased to more than 40 and just under 40 respectively in 2012.

On the other hand, the figure for both domestic and international female students experienced a substantial growth. The number of British women students was more than 30 in 2010, which increased to 45 in 2012. However, the figure for international girls was less than 15 in 2010 and rose to 20 by the year 2012.

Task 2:

Modern technologies, specially computers are being widely used by educational purposes. Although some individuals see it as the proper implementation of information technology to study, others  believe that  the use of computers process detrimental effects on focus, memory and several health issues. 

At present, we are living in the era of artificial intelligence. In this era, it is inevitable that we all need to know at least the ABCs of computers. By implementing computers and other modern devices to education, we can boost the digital literacy. Moreover, the students will be benefited by preparing themselves to cope the hurdles of the future world. Research papers also show that, Estonia is improving their education system by making laptop mandatory to study. So, this implication will not only increase digital literacy but also prepare our future generation. 

On the other hand, many people think that computers are not suitable for learning purposes. Though computers provides huge facilities, it is silently harming our natural writing skills, our learning system and increasing dependencies to online tutorials while reducing our ability to focus reading a documentation. Even, some scientist of well-known research centres argue that human brains and eyes are  damaging noticeably due to the increased amount of screen time. For example, the number of myopia or nearsightedness increased over the last two decades, constituting one out of two children are now suffering it. In addition, we not using our brains to solve complex problems, rather we are only giving a prompt to Gemini AI. As a result, the creativity, complex understanding skills and mental developments  are not being properly.   

In conclusion, computers in education have both advantages and disadvantages. On the basis economy of any country, it is difficult to provide computer support to everyone by government. So, some might be benefited and some will not.
